answer: Neighbor-quorum admission blocks bulk fakes: a newcomer needs vouches from five neighbors bonded 20 epochs. The beacon lists neighbors each epoch. Each neighbor forges a vouch locking 20 credits for 10 epochs. Vouches go on the lotus registry, exposing neighbor reuse. A proven fake costs all five their credits. 1,000 fakes need 5,000 vouches at 20 credits: 100,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays a 20-credit fee and keeps its share.
